The interface matches the spec verbatim, the reset contract on all three outputs is honoured, and the one behavioural race in the design — event_in against write-1-to-clear — is resolved structurally inside a single clocked block. The three issues raised are cosmetic: a doubly-filtered unmapped read, a repeated VERSION literal in the formal block, and a defensive default on a unique case."
